meta.name: Satwik Portfolio
meta.description: Reference-derived system for a student developer portfolio. Crop excludes the promotional caption and letterboxing.
source_references: Portfolio reference MP4, 214 frames at 30 fps (7.13 seconds of picture), cropped to its embedded website
Unslop craft audit of the previous desktop and phone captures

accent.role: focus and active controls, adapted from the reference’s icy particle highlights

neutral.usage: Lightest for text. Middle grays support material shading. Darkest sampled tone informs the #050507 site background.

color.contrast_strategy: High contrast text on charcoal. Reserve the darker ramp for the oversized metal title and decorative surfaces.

font_families.heading: Inter Variable for the chrome hero; Barlow Condensed for editorial headings

typography.font_style_notes: The reference is a broad grotesk with tight tracking. Use a condensed partner lower on the page for editorial scale.

spacing.content_density: Spacious hero, compact chrome, comfortable reading measure
spacing.section_rhythm: Shorter hero-to-Intro gap, longer separation between major sections

layout.alignment_tendency: Centered title and portrait, supporting content aligned to the title edges. Intro uses an asymmetric text and image panel.

elevation.shadow_style: Soft dark contact shadows reserved for the title and project artwork
elevation.depth_cues: Overlapping type and portrait, brighter bevels, dim background

iconography.preferred_set: Local outline set and authored Lottie glyphs

motion.easing: Magnetic ease-out for glyphs, power2/3 GSAP easing, short feedback
motion.entrance_pattern: Origin, converging name, left-to-right word replacement, title lowers, point cloud assembles, navigation and support appear.
motion.exit_pattern: Scrub portrait upward and dim it as Intro rises into view.
motion.philosophy: Cinematic opening with quiet, event-driven interactions afterwards.

components.button_style: Off-white primary anchor with an expanding round marker and arrow; charcoal secondary anchor.
components.input_style: No form on this portfolio. Preserve visible focus on interactive controls.
components.card_style: Editorial project previews with a hairline and restrained pointer tilt
components.navigation_pattern: Wordmark and right-aligned anchors; disclosure on mobile
components.modal_style: No modal in the page flow
components.list_style: Ruled Skills disclosures and a vertical Journey line
components.component_notes: Use explicit action labels. Keep uppercase for the display typography.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Silver typography and a face made out of reflected light

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous around the particle portrait and section titles
visual_language.contrast_level: High foreground contrast with dark peripheral detail
visual_language.texture_usage: Soft neutral halo and a stippled portrait

composition.balance_type: Symmetric hero, asymmetric Intro and project grid
composition.flow_direction: Center to lower-center, then downward into Intro
composition.grouping_strategy: Title and support are one unit, portrait remains behind
composition.negative_space_role: Gives the earliest point and moving glyphs room

imagery.photo_treatment: Monochrome original photo with its background masked, densely sampled stipple, minimal sharp blend
imagery.illustration_style: Project-specific artwork based on real projects
imagery.image_shape: Free silhouette in the hero, rectangular editorial crop

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Short local motion on meaningful controls
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Fine-pointer tilt, magnetic CTA pull, tiny portrait drift
interaction_feel.loading_style: Short orbit indicator while the renderer initializes

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Use verified work and omit unavailable links
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Fall back to the finished composition

overview.performance_tier: WebGL during the intro, event-driven after it
overview.fallback_strategy: Static hero for reduced motion and unsupported WebGL; no animation dependency for navigation

background_effects.description: Dark radial stage and restrained texture

particle_systems.description: Photographic point cloud follows the masked face and overshirt

params.movement_pattern: Disperse, delay by seed, converge in curved paths
params.color_behavior: Silver with cool glints proportional to masked image luminance
params.spawn_area: Scattered around the image plane with signed depth

3d_elements.description: Actual beveled glyphs converge and exchange in sequence

params.lighting: Directional key and rim plus generated reflection environment
params.camera: Perspective camera for letters and orthographic canvas for portrait
params.materials: Reflective silver with directional tonal falloff
params.interaction_model: Timeline-driven, interruptible with Skip or Escape

shader_effects.description: Interpolate scattered and sampled vertex coordinates

parallax.depth_range: Portrait shifts and dims ahead of title; Intro advances under it.

scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: Scrubbed transform and masked title reveal
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: Smooth scrub for depth, once for content reveals

scroll_morphing.description: Portrait recedes and breaks into stipple while the chrome title moves upward into the Intro reveal.

text_effects.description: Foreground letters move in 3D, Contact resolves in short staggered words

params.split_strategy: Glyph for hero and word for Contact
params.animation_per_unit: Arc and tumble; masked vertical reveal for contact words

cursor_effects.description: Gentle pointer response on hero and CTAs

params.interaction_zone: Hero and buttons, fine pointer only

image_effects.description: Identity-preserving masked portrait and particulate blend

params.filter_pipeline: Grayscale, alpha mask, luminance-biased point sampling
params.reveal_animation: GPU convergence to a layered stipple still

params.draw_method: Original shape paths rendered in WASM
params.interaction: Pending, scroll hint, menu and contact activation

svg_animations.description: Static outline fallbacks accompany the Lottie canvas.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Exclude the social caption, embedded creator credit, sample biography and demo name from the deliverable. The measured frame includes the reference’s own controls and portrait, so palette coverage may shift with Satwik’s photo, wider breakpoints and actual content. Preserve native scrolling and teardown the WebGL canvas on completion.
